svg.title: Derivation map
svg.desc: Eleven blocks derive every table from the metric and the orientation of the volume element, in the order of the code: bases, metric, parts, transitional products, interior products, geometric products, norms, properties, measures, projections and motion operators. Each block takes its inputs from other blocks on a top row, in one box for each block that they come from, with one line from each box, and builds downward. Each box holds a symbol, and each line carries its formula and the function that builds the table. Faded lines are routes that the code does not take, and faded boxes are operators with no table.
